errors.text_span: For 2012, the bar is entirely green at about 1.0 (2–4); for 2013, the bar is entirely blue at about 1.0 (0). In 2014, the bar is split into blue (~0.5) and orange (~0.5); in 2015, it is split into blue (~0.5) and green (~0.5). In 2022, the stacked bar is rendered in lighter (more transparent) shades of the same palette, with approximate segment heights of blue (~0.33), orange (~0.28–0.30), green (~0.20–0.22), and red (~0.15–0.18), and no clearly visible purple segment;
errors.evidence: The description provides an exhaustive, year-by-year, segment-by-segment breakdown of the entire chart. While the prompt asks for a description of each bar, this level of detail is excessive and reduces readability. A more concise summary with representative examples would be more effective, as suggested by the prompt's instruction to include 'representative values from the shortest and tallest bars or note consistent trends'.
